runtimeDescription: The queue dispatches on demand. No execution workers remain idle, and new jobs start immediately when capacity is available.
concurrencyDescription: Limit the number of top-level background jobs this EasySSH instance can run concurrently.
maxConcurrencyDescription: Allowed range: 1–16. Changes take effect immediately; the default is 2.
concurrencyHint: This setting limits top-level jobs such as task.execute, batch.execute, and transfer.execute. It is not the final total of SSH or transfer connections. Reducing it does not interrupt running jobs; it only pauses new claims.
scalingDownHint: {active} jobs are still running. The runtime will gradually scale down to {max} as they finish.
